text: What engineering courses are available at MESCOE?
response: MESCOE offers UG (B.E.) programs in Computer, E&TC, Mechanical, and Automation & Robotics Engineering, along with PG (M.E.) programs.

text: Which departments exist in Wadia college of engineering?
response: Departments include Computer Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication (E&TC), Mechanical Engineering, and Automation & Robotics.

text: Tell me about the degree programs offered at MESCOE.
response: MESCOE offers B.E. degrees in Computer, E&TC, Mechanical, and Automation & Robotics, plus M.E. programs in Signal Processing, Design, and Computer Engineering.

text: What branches can I study at MES Wadia College of Engineering?
response: You can choose between Computer Engineering, E&TC, Mechanical Engineering, or Automation & Robotics.
